geometry_edits.rationale: Replace the radial array with a bent-bar path to establish one continuous hall gesture and remove self-collision.
Limit the curvature so the mass reads as a linear hall rather than a torqued stack.
Author a gym-appropriate daylight roof section that expresses span.
Align the hall section with the long-span direction to support the gymnasium contract.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the radial repetition with a continuous bent ribbon logic so the dominant mass reads as one hall-like gesture instead of a cluster.
Reduce the excessive twist so the primary form becomes legible as a long-span datum.
Shift the roof/section toward a gym-appropriate monitor or daylight hall profile instead of a sawtooth-like arbitrary cascade.
Keep the section aligned to a clear long-span axis so the hall reads coherently in section.

rationale: The candidate fails as a gymnasium massing because the visible form reads as a twisted, self-colliding cluster rather than one clear long-span hall with a subordinate support bar. Across views, the silhouette changes too drastically: it is coherent only in fragments, with no stable dominant volume, no legible entry/service hierarchy, and almost no meaningful public void or court-like ground response. The roof/section language is especially problematic for the program contract: instead of a clear span expression or daylight hall logic, it produces an arbitrary stepped/torqued mass that obscures the hall condition. Some repair integrity remains because the object is closed and not visibly exploded, but the primary gesture is weak, too fragmented, and typologically closer to an abstract sculptural stack than a sports hall.
